title: Letters of the soul: the garments of thought, speech and action

lectures.id: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

overview:
This chapter begins the next stage of the *ma'amar*. It explains the garments (*levush*) of thought, speech and action, starting with the source of letters: they are in the essence of the soul itself, not received from outside. The soul has two kinds of letters, letters of thought and letters of speech.

Thought comes out in three levels: a bare image with no letters, the same experience cut into separate parts, and those parts arranged by logical thought. Speech has three levels too: a medium such as breath or sound, the unique letters, and letters combined into words.

Letters also make a desire definable. They turn a hidden will into a clear object, so that it can be revealed in intellect as a reason and pass into the emotions, such as love or fear. The same will appears in each garment without changing its essence.

The chapter ends with the chain of descent. Letters run from the essence of the light down through each level to action, and at each level the will changes its nature.

blocks.text: We use intellect, made of a different material, to express our desire: that is a *mashal*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Letters can be both a *kli*, a vessel, and a *levush*, a garment. Letters essential to a thing belong to thought; letters we take up as a symbol are the garment. We do both all the time.

blocks.title: Smiles and handshakes
blocks.text: When we smile, or shake hands, we make a physical gesture that represents how we feel. We cannot see how a person feels inside; we infer it from external things, which are themselves symbols.

blocks.title: Gravity, which nobody sees
blocks.text: Science works the same way. We see an external event and say it is a symptom of something inside, a hidden law. Nobody sees gravity directly; we see things fall and conclude there is a cosmic law making everything work. So there are always two sides, internal and external.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: On the level of the *nimshal*, what the analogy stands for: *sovev kol almin* (the light that encompasses all worlds) is called thought, and *memalei kol almin* (the light that fills all worlds) is called speech.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The Alter Rebbe has a great *maamar* on this distinction. We experience every day that we are alive and conscious, but we do not know what the soul is. We experience that we have it directly, but not its essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: What we do know and experience is *memalei kol almin*: G-d's speech, reaching us in the body, external to the essence of the soul, and so symbolic and detached from that essence. The real essence we cannot know or wrap our minds around. That is G-d's thought, which is hidden from us.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Something hot

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: What another person is thinking

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The same applies to Torah. Its revealed parts are the *dibur* (speech), and its inner parts, the *pnimiyus HaTorah*, are the *machshava* (thought).

blocks.text: As we talked about with *igulim* and *yosher*, whatever we want starts as an inner desire, like feeling at home, and we associate it with something outside, like a house. It is, you could say, like setting goals.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Then the desire develops: work out what you want and go through getting it. *Ratzon* is choosing to care about something outside oneself and make it an object of desire.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The internal state is *machshava*. Attaching oneself to something outside, so its symbols reflect on oneself, is the essential ability of speech. Things outside change how we feel only if we decide to connect and care.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Caring about appearance, and about money
blocks.text: Someone who does not care how they look feels no reflection on themselves; one who cares does. Someone who cares about money enjoys making it; one who does not attach to it, not as much.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So we attach our self-expression to outside things, moving from *taanug* to *ratzon*. In desire we do not yet enjoy the thing, since we do not have it; once we have it we experience its *taanug*. Attaching inner state to outside things, which is speech, gives us *taanug* and then *ratzon*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: These two powers are the essence of letters: the ability to have any *yesh* and any particular desired thing.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: The 22 letters, and the hidden will revealed in intellect
sections.summary: The letters of the soul are its 22 powers and movements. Through them the hidden will is defined clearly enough to be revealed in intellect, where it appears as a reason for what I want.

phrases.en: it's the ability to reveal and express

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: a certain thing from the essence

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: Like it says in

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that there are 22 letters that are essentially like G-d put into our soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and these are 22 different powers or abilities

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: they're also 22 different movements, different ways that our soul can have a change of state

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Through letters the hidden *hiyuli* is revealed: the ability to express a thing from the soul's essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The power of letters is that I can define for myself what I want, and become conscious of it. The same goes for knowing what I am thinking and what I am feeling.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: As *Likkutei Amarim* says, there are 22 letters fixed in the soul, which G-d put into it. They are 22 powers and 22 movements of the soul, and each change of state gives a different sensation or ability.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In Kabbalah, the Tree of the ten *sefiros*, drawn with all the lines joined, has 22 lines, each a letter.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: From *chachma* to *bina* is one letter; *chesed* to *gevura* another. The soul connects states in different combinations.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So letters are the ability to experience the states of the ten *sefiros*, the ten powers, and carve out different sensations in different combinations.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: through these letters

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: first of all, we can know what we want

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: but then we can also take what we want and have it be revealed

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: if our desire would not become expressed and defined in letters

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: דהיינו מה שנראה למהות ומציאת רצון,
phrases.en: if we don't clearly define to ourself what we want

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: לא היה בא הרצון העצמי הנעלם בלבוש אחר
phrases.en: then this essential *ratzon* would not be able to come into this external *levush*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: of intellect where it's changing from the *mahus* of *ratzon* to

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: which is now the intellect being expressed as a reason

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: I want this because of this

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Through these letters we first know what we want, then take it and have it revealed in intellect. That gives each power its essential revelation. From desire we communicate it to intellect, and then create justifications or a plan.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: If desire were not revealed in letters, that is, not clearly defined for ourselves, the hidden essential desire could not pass into another garment, from one essence to another, into intellect.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A reason in intellect is a garment of desire. Really, I want it just because I want it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: To put a reason into words, the desire has to be defined in letters, which can then be translated from one language into another. The reason is only a way of expressing or justifying the desire, whether it is more or less true. If I do not clearly define what I want, I cannot put it into words.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: The will in intellect and in emotion: the same will in other garments
sections.summary: The essential will does not change. Through its letters it is expressed above intellect, in intellect, and in the emotions. The class gives the examples of love, of the face, and of automatic reactions.

phrases.en: which is called the *chachma* of the *ratzon*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: מה שנראה למציאת טעם לרצון הוא בחינת אותיות שבו
על ידי זה יורד ממהות למהות המדות
phrases.en: it can descend again from one nature to another into emotions

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the emotions of the ratzon

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Once desire is expressed in intellect as the *chachma* of the will, a clearly defined reason, it can descend into emotions, the emotions of the will.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: to have a love related to that *ratzon*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שגם הוא אינו רק מציאת רצון,
phrases.en: it's still just the desire

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that it's just now being expressed in the *middah* of love

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: but really, because I want it, that's why I love it

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and so, like the word *ahavah* comes from the word *ah*, which means your desire

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: והה''א ה' חסדים המתפשטים מחכמה ובינה
phrases.en: and then the *heh* that's added to make it is the five *chasadim* from *chachma* and *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: There is a love related to that will. It is the same will clothed in love; from the side of the will, it loves because it wants.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Sometimes I want to understand, and intellect is objective. Sometimes I want to accomplish something, and intellect supplies the justifying reason.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: A boy who wants to drive
blocks.text: A child wants to start driving, and comes up with a reason: he will get to school and help with chores.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: Mixing desire with the Rebbe's sales
blocks.text: A *bachur* said he'd use it for *mivtzoim*; the Rebbe: don't mix *taavah* with my *mivtzoim*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: People often create justifications that are disingenuous. You see this a lot in things like politics: for many people the philosophy comes after what they want, their side wants to win, and they build a whole worldview around that. Their feelings are generated by what they want to be true, and so they do not come from a true love of the thing. That can be good or bad; it is just the way we work.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

sensitivity.reason: A jab at political partisans in general (their side wants to win; feelings built on a worldview). No side is named; the teaching is the disingenuous justification.
sensitivity.publishable: People often create justifications that are disingenuous. You see this a lot: for many people the philosophy comes after what they want, their side wants to win, and they build a whole worldview around that. Their feelings are generated by what they want to be true, and so they do not come from a true love of the thing. That can be good or bad; it is just the way we work.

blocks.text: The word *ahavah* (love) comes from *ave*, desire, and its *heh* is the five *chasadim* from *chachma* and *bina*. When a desire is processed through intellect, which defines it (these things will be good for you, so love them; these will harm what you want, so fear or hate them), it becomes love.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: And so the essential desire is really the same

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: both when it's expressed within the intellect

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: והוא עצם הרצון בהיותו עדיין למעלה מהשכל וטעם כו'
phrases.en: and when it was higher than intellect

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: But through the power of these letters, this desire can change its garments

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: נשתנה ונראה בלמעלה מן השכל ובשכל ובמדות
phrases.en: and can be expressed higher than intellect or in intellect or in emotions

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The essential desire is the same whether expressed in intellect or higher than intellect; it does not change. It is expressed in different languages: of desire, intellect, emotion, ways of translating it within ourselves and to others.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Through these letters desire can change its garments and be expressed higher than intellect, in intellect, or in emotions. It is the same essential thing, as the same thing is said in English, French or Hebrew: only the letters change.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The Arizal and the Zohar speak of letters on the whole body: the face, the hands, everything. The Gemara says a person's face is an open book, *reshus harabim*, public property. A person can try to mask it, but how they think and feel produces involuntary responses, even in the face.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: It is not that each body part is a letter. There are mannerisms, expressed on every part of the body, that are automatic expressions of something inside. The face is called *panim* because it reveals what is inside. Certain facial expressions are universal for certain feelings, such as anger, fear and disgust; people can be trained to read them.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: In the same way, certain thoughts automatically trigger certain emotions. These built-in connections are hardwired in us, as it is natural for a baby to cry or to laugh. They are external garments of something internal.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So the inner desire and inner pleasure are revealed. A person's face shines when they are enjoying something, and there are connections between wanting certain things, thinking certain things and feeling certain things. Psychologically, spiritually and physically, all of this connects; these are the letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: And so, too, there's certain letters to express the emotions for a desire

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שהוא מה שנראה האהבה שברצון במציאת יש כו'

blocks.text: So too the emotions of desire have their letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: Letters run through thought, speech and action: each stage needs its own letters
sections.summary: Will, intellect and emotion each have their own letters, and every stage must be defined by letters before it can be translated into the next. That is why an understanding can produce an emotion, and why putting thought into words clarifies it.

phrases.en: the desire is expressed in actual thought, speech, and action

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: they all have their own unique letters

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: there are specific letters for that

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: and so, okay, so that's the whole *hishtalshelus* of how a desire is going to go through all these different stages

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: So, too, when a person goes from the realm of intellect

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Desire is expressed in thought, speech and action, down to the deed, and each has its own letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Each has its *chomer*, its medium. Intellect has a quality that makes it intellect, and it is organized in certain ways when it thinks about this or that. Emotions have their own quality, their *chomer*, and they are organized and formed into the feelings of love and fear.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Thought too gets caught up in speech and action. All have their *chomer*, organized in different patterns.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Here a person envisions the deed, and the desire becomes, "I want to do this set of actions." Those have specific letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: That is the whole *hishtalshelus* of desire: at each stage it changes into different letters, which let it be translated to the next stage.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Likewise, pure *sechel*, simply trying to understand, is the intellect itself, not intellect within a desire.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: שאם לא היה השכל במציאת אותיות השכל, שהוא בחינת גלוי השכל במציאת,
phrases.en: if a person wouldn't have letters, they wouldn't be able to basically define their thought. They wouldn't know what they're thinking

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: איך היה השכל בא בשינוי המהות בהתפעלות
phrases.en: So, then the idea wouldn't be able to go from intellect to create a *hispaalus*, an emotion

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: that's only possible because it's still the same intellect

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the understanding is what's driving the emotion

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: it's just that that understanding is now being expressed in the *levush* of an emotion of love or fear, or whatever it is

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אין זה רק על ידי האותיות שבו
phrases.en: that's only possible through the letters of that

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Without letters a person cannot define what they think, so the idea cannot pass from intellect into an emotion.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So if a person cannot define what they understand and put it into words for themselves, they cannot translate it into a feeling, and no emotion comes out of it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A realization from *hisbonenus* or learning can excite or scare us: a person sees a lion and wants to run. That is possible only because it is still the same intellect; the understanding drives the emotion.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The emotion expresses that worldview, which is why much psychology aims to change how we interpret events: the interpretation drives the feeling.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The understanding is now clothed in the garment of love or fear.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Only the letters allow one thing to become another.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: וכן על דרך זה אותיות דמדות במחשבה
phrases.en: and in a similar way, for a person to express their feelings to themselves in your thought

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אם לא היה המדה במציאת יש באותיות,
phrases.en: if each emotion didn't have a unique set of experiences

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: how would you know how you're feeling

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: the same thing with the thought to speech

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A person must express feelings to themselves in thought. Children are trained to identify an emotion and its signs: when angry, I breathe this way and feel tense.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Once I recognize that I am feeling a certain emotion and define it, I can think about it. Sometimes we have a feeling but cannot say what is going on; we just feel different. Being able to name the emotion is what lets us think about it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Even emojis try to express emotion. If each emotion had no unique set of experiences defining it, how would you know how you feel?

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: So there is a correlation: tense with these symptoms is one emotion, relaxed with those is another.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Because an emotion is defined and predictable, it can be represented by something else, named and thought about. We can have a richer experience, self-awareness of it, and then change it actively.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: Without letters for our *middos* they could not go into thought, and without clear definitions of thought we could not put it into words. That is why having to explain something helps clarify what we think.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

sections.title: The chain of descent from essence to action
sections.summary: Letters go down from level to level, from the essence of the light to action. On each level G-d defines the form of the essence and its expression, so the will changes its nature and descends to the physical world. The class then returns to the Torah, the will in the world, and the general idea of the perek.

phrases.he: ונמצא על ידי האותיות יש בחינת השתלשלות עילה ועלול מעצם הנפש עד סוף מעשה,
phrases.en: So, it comes out that these letters are integral

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: ושרש האותיות הוא בעצם הנפש ממש
phrases.en: and again, the source of these letters is all the way in the essence of the soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: יובן בשרש ומחצב האותיות בעצם הנפש, שמתהווים עם עצם אור הנפש כאחד
כמו שמתהווה בחי כח התנועה עמו
phrases.en: just like we have the ability to move that's an essential part of being a living soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: These letters run through the whole *hishtalshelus*, from the essence of the soul to action. At each stage the letters of that stage define it, then translate it into the next stage's letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The source of these letters is in the essence of the soul itself. Every experience is experienced in our essence, and part of how it is experienced, expressed and translated is a choice, and part is simply hardwired. That gives us awareness and control: we can reorganize the letters by thinking or acting differently, and so have choice.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: To get control over something internal, we often work through something external. Speaking can change how we think and feel; learning something and putting it into intellect can change what we want and enjoy. So we give the internal an external, symbolic form, which is the idea of speech.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The letters have their root in the essence of the soul, coming into being with its essential light. Being too intellectual can take us out of the experience, so there is a trade-off. An example of the revealed aspect of *yechidah* is a little child dancing, not self-conscious: pure self-expression, the letters of *taanug* when pure in thought too.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The letters are created with the soul, like the essential power of movement in a living being. Likewise we express ourselves internally in language, then in symbols, from one level to the next. That is the *mashal*; the *nimshal* he tends to give in the same chapter in these later chapters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: והנמשל מכל זה הרי מובן ממילא, דאותיות שבטהירו עילאה
phrases.en: And so when we talked about back in chapter 10

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: it says *galaf galifo*, which is the idea that there's like these two types of letters

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: כו', היינו בחינת אותיות העצמיים דמחשבה ודבור שבעצמות אור אין סוף
phrases.en: In other words, that G-d, within His essential ability to do anything, He has the ability to both have something be an expression within the self

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.en: just like in our soul we have these essential two abilities of having our internal experience, which we can't really share

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

phrases.he: אותיות הקבועים בעצם הנפש דיחידה כו'

phrases.en: like we talked about the three levels, *Yachid*, *echad*, *kadmon*, within the soul

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The *nimshal*: in the upper purity, before the *tzimtzum*, G-d engraved letters (*galaf galifo*), of thought and of speech. Within His essential ability He has an expression within Himself, and also an expression we can understand.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The first is *sovev kol almin*, that which encompasses all worlds, the essential. The second is *memalei kol almin*, that which fills all worlds, expressed outside the self. These relate in general to revelation and concealment, *gilui* and *helem*, and to the unlimited and the limited: G-d can be infinite and finite, transcend limits and be within limits.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The color red
blocks.text: Like the soul's two abilities, our inner experience cannot be shared. I cannot know whether your red is my red, since it is internal. But I can express it and talk about it. Those are the two sides of letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: G-d creates things that are infinite and beyond creation, which we cannot know though they affect us. Most of our existence comes from *sovev kol almin*, such as the very fact that we exist. We do not grasp that, but it is there. The part we can know is speech.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The infinite light has the same three levels, *yachid*, *echad*, *kadmon*, and on each level these two aspects of letters.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: These letters descend level by level, from the simple *ratzon* before the *tzimtzum* through *Adam Kadmon*, *Abba* and *Imma* to *Nukva* of *Atzilus*. On each level G-d chooses the form of its essence and how it is expressed below.

blocks.text: The light changes its nature level by level: from essential *ratzon*, to *taanug*, *ratzon*, *sechel* and the middos, through the letters of each essence, which reveal a defined *yesh*.

blocks.title: G-d chooses the form of each level
blocks.text: G-d chose to give *ratzon* a definition: He creates the ten *sefiros* and defines them, and puts into the world that He wants things a certain way.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: A tree grows because a desire pushing it to grow is G-d's *ratzon* in it. There is no logic to why it should gather energy, but a consistent *ratzon* is imbued in the world, and that lets us build *sechel*, laws of nature and mathematics.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: Digression that follows line 49 and reads no line (words 9226 to 10599). Placed here because it expands the descent of the will that line 49 states.

blocks.text: Gravity works as it does because it is a fact put into the world, not because it is logical. We build mathematics to understand something inherently *ratzon*.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: The same with Torah and mitzvos: G-d says certain things are *godly* and certain are moral, and puts those essentials into the world. In us too He puts an essential nature: godly compulsions to be curious, to want truth, to do right, to contribute and have empathy. That is not our choice; we choose how to express it.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.text: G-d also creates patterns in the world and in us: we see certain things as logical, graceful and beautiful. Once intellect is set this way it relates to emotions: this will be good for me, this bad, so we make predictions. That is what lets us have feelings about things; the same holds for Torah and mitzvos.

blocks.text: We understand Torah, and so can *psak* what is good and bad, *tahor* and *tamei*. Without a logic defining it we could not *psak*. So all these systems get defined.

blocks.title: The danger of the pardes
blocks.text: There is a danger in the *pardes*, as the class put it: recognizing that things have no essential meaning. The *Zohar* compares Torah to interpreting a dream, but unlike a dream one must interpret on the basis of truth.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The G-dly soul in psak
blocks.text: There is a system of the thirteen middos, and within that system there is flexibility. Beyond that, there is *ruach hakodesh*: G-d puts into us a G-dly soul, and to *psak* properly one has to develop it and become aware of it. When someone *psaks* from that awareness of the inner soul, it is the word of G-d speaking through them; that is how G-d puts truth into us and into the world. But one first has to uncover it and find it within oneself.

audio.lecture: Walters 5784 Edited/038 Shaar HaYichud ch 38 enhanced.mp3

blocks.title: The light of Torah and the exile of the shechinah
blocks.text: The light of Torah is above our heads: we were given its essence. Too much involvement in materialism covers it over and we lose our awareness of it. That is the idea of the *shechinah* leaving after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, the exile of the *shechinah*, which we have to bring back.

blocks.text: One must first understand faithfully what all the commentaries say. Humility, *bittul* and discipline train us so we do not warp things. When we show we can do that consistently, we develop the ability to become aware of that *godliness* within us, which allows a true *chiddush*.

blocks.text: Likewise with *hisbonenus*: before a *chiddush* you go through the length and breadth, with *bittul*, not just coming up with new things.

blocks.text: The *mishkan* is the idea: it has to be *lishmah*, a safe space in which we develop and reveal the *shechinah* through Torah and mitzvos. From there we go out and find G-d in everything, *bechol derachecha daehu*. Understanding the way Torah is taught lets us apply it in new ways, but the *bittul* must come first.

blocks.text: That is the whole idea of *chinuch*: first a safe space to develop and mature, then you go out and become independent.
